title: 布里茨·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 黄铜圆桶胸膛配小巧机械头，巨大的分节双臂构成厚实轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Blitzcrank is a heavy brass automaton with an enormous barrel chest, small mechanical head, glowing blue eyes, broad shoulder plates, huge segmented arms and fists, and short sturdy metal legs. Preserve the recognizable mechanical proportions and rear steam pipes, with both hands attached and relaxed. His surfaces are intact manufactured armor, not a human body or skin, and no rocket punch is deployed.
art_direction.scene: A balanced near-frontal full character, subtle contrapposto if anatomically appropriate, silhouette opening into a large quiet paper field. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: brass gold, petrol blue, warm rust, window ivory; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
